rule: Big match = India playing (any sport, the Asian Games included), IPL / WPL, an ICC event, ISL, or a World Cup / Champions League final, from the fixture calendar. Window = start − 30 min … estimated end + 60 min. Start: the time on the calendar row, else the usual start for that format in India (typical), else the whole match day 09:00–24:00 IST. No score source is used.
scores_note: No official free score source — scores are not shown.
